00001 MODULE branchmod
00002   USE parameters
00003 CONTAINS
00004   FUNCTION branching(r1,r2,pr)
00005     IMPLICIT NONE
00006     INTEGER :: branching
00007     INTEGER :: r1,r2,pr ! Indices of the reaction look-up-table
00008     INTEGER :: prods(3)
00009     INTEGER :: reaction(5)
00010     REAL    :: rnum
00011     CHARACTER(80) :: varfmt
00012 
00013     prods = 0
00014     reaction = 0

00017     firstcall: IF ( pr .EQ. 1 ) THEN
00018        CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(rnum)
00019        prods = REACT_CUBE(r1,r2,:)
00020 
00021        !****************************************************************************
00022        !**** BRANCHING RATIOS ******************************************************
00023        !****************************************************************************
00024        isdis: IF ( (r1 .EQ. EXCNUM) .OR. (r2 .EQ. EXCNUM) ) THEN
00025           IF ( (r1 .EQ. O2NUM) .OR. (r2 .EQ. O2NUM) ) THEN
00026              IF ( rnum .LE. O2_DISPROB ) THEN
00027                 prods = (/ ONUM, ONUM, 0 /)
00028              ELSE
00029                 prods = (/ 0, 0, 0 /)
00030              END IF
00031           ELSE IF ( (r1 .EQ. O3NUM) .OR. (r2 .EQ. O3NUM) ) THEN
00032              IF ( rnum .LE. O3_DISPROB) THEN
00033                 prods = (/ O2NUM, ONUM, 0 /)
00034              ELSE
00035                 prods = (/ 0, 0, 0 /)
00036              END IF
00037           END IF
00038        ELSE
00039           branchcond: IF ( r1 .EQ. 2 .AND. r2 .EQ. 3 .OR. r1 .EQ. 3 .AND. r2 .EQ. 2 ) THEN
00040              IF ( rnum .LE. O2_DISPROB ) THEN
00041                 ! O2+ + O2- -> O2* + O2 -> O + O + O2
00042                 prods = (/ ONUM, ONUM, O2NUM /)
00043              ELSE
00044                 ! O2+ + O2- -> O2 + O2
00045                 prods = (/ O2NUM, O2NUM, 0 /)
00046              END IF
00047           ELSE IF ( r1 .EQ. 2 .AND. r2 .EQ. ELECNUM .OR. r1 .EQ. ELECNUM .AND. r2 .EQ. 2 ) THEN
00048              IF ( rnum .LE. O2_DISPROB ) THEN
00049                 ! e + O2+ -> O2* -> O + O
00050                 prods = (/ ONUM, ONUM, 0 /)
00051              ELSE
00052                 ! e + O2+ -> O2
00053                 prods = (/ O2NUM, 0, 0 /)
00054              END IF
00055           END IF branchcond
00056 
00057           ! If none of the conditionals proc, the react cube should get the original values
00058           REACT_CUBE(r1,r2,:) = prods
00059        END IF isdis
00060     END IF firstcall
00061 
00062     reaction(1) = r1
00063     reaction(2) = r2
00064     reaction(3:5) = prods
00065     ! If checking reactions, print out reactants and products
00066     o3check: IF ( (O3_ANALYTICS .EQV. .TRUE.) ) THEN
00067        IF ( ANY(reaction .EQ. O3NUM) ) THEN
